svg.text: Proposed construction · millimetres · drawings explain assembly; no fabrication certification
02 / Rear: finished covering and protective fittings
Developed spine wrap · repair at tail · schematic
03 / Fore-edge elevation — separate boards, coverings and accumulated paper
Hardware, endcaps and rounded spine are outside this nominal layer stack.
55 mm neutral spine path; source geometry, no force solution.
05 / Enlarged capped board/text-block section — proposed layers
Section cuts are explicitly capped and hatched. Thicknesses enlarged independently for clarity.
Five 2.4 mm supports at Z = −110, −55, 0, 55, 110 mm. Flattened ends sit in inner-board channels.
Spine: 0.9 mm covering / 0.05 mm proposed adhesive / 0.35 mm lining. Concealed routing remains proposed.
The cradle is externally positioned. Page motion is a controlled geometric study; no gravity or paper-stress simulation is claimed.
All solid components retain physical thickness. Fine grain, ink and fibres are surface maps.
